title: Noise atom

reference.note: held locally; this page carries statistics measured from it and none of its pixels

summary: One clumped speckle field makes the blue ground and then eats the mint orbits, the halo and the core drawn over it.
units: reference pixels; the plate is 736 × 736 and every length scales with the canvas

clump.does: Scale of the clump field: the reference's ground correlates 0.88 at lag 1 and 0.49 at lag 4.

specks.does: Share of pixels that land a bright speck, mint or pale, one pixel each. 36 per 1000 in the reference ground.

speckSoft.does: Blur of each speck into a blob: at 1 px a speck is 3 px wide with a bright center, as the reference's are.

patch.does: A slow field that gathers the clumps into patches, so the ground correlates over 6 px as the reference does.

bite.does: How much of the lit parts the dark clumps eat. 1 breaks every stroke into specks.

grain.does: Per-pixel video noise on top, a little bluer than neutral.

soft.does: Blur before the final speckle; the reference's specks are 2 to 3 px soft blobs.

rings.does: Number of elliptical orbits around the core.

squash.does: Short axis over long axis: how edge-on the orbits are seen.

tilt.does: Angle of the first orbit; the rest spread evenly from it.

stroke.does: Width of the orbit stroke at full ink. 12 to 16 px in the reference, measured across a ring on the center row.

wobble.does: Radius noise along each orbit, so the line is hand-drawn rather than geometric.

dry.does: Where along the orbit the brush runs dry and the line breaks. 0 is a solid line.

glow.does: Exponential reach of the halo: 1 is 90 px.

halo.does: Brightness of the halo. Above 1 the inner halo clips to pale.

scan.does: Height of the single horizontal scan line relative to the core.

phase.does: Position along the loop. Precesses the orbits, alternate ones the other way.

seed.does: Re-rolls the speckle, the orbits and the wobble.

modes.saw: value up to value + amp over period seconds, then again
modes.drift: seeded walk, one step of up to amp every period seconds, folded back at the slider ends

motion.runs: only while Motion is on, at half scale; the sliders hold the center values; off by default

live.runs: only while Live is on: a drag on the figure sets x across and y down between these ends; off by default

techniques.name: Grain
techniques.implementation: Ground: two blues cut from one 2.6 px clump field, bright specks on 36 of 1000 pixels.

techniques.name: Pull
techniques.implementation: The core: a 34 px faceted polygon in three tints inside a halo that peaks at 60 px.

techniques.name: Edge
techniques.implementation: An orbit stroke: 11 px gaussian core with a faint fringe, wobbling 5 px, bitten by the clump field.

pass_order: ground: a value-noise clump field at 2.6 px, cut between two blues (dark 54 %, blue 35 % in the reference corner)
orbits: 4 ellipses about the core at 45° steps from the tilt; per pixel the signed distance to each in its own frame, minus a 5 px wobble from noise along the angle
stroke: a gaussian core 11 px wide plus a wider faint fringe, multiplied by a dry field that breaks the line
halo: exponential with a 90 px reach, hollowed near the center so it peaks about 60 px out, clipping to pale where it exceeds 1
core: a 34 px faceted polygon with three tints, lit from upper left
one scan line 2.5 px high, brightness jittered along x
0.7 px blur, then the clump field eats the lit parts, bright specks land on 36 of 1000 pixels, per-pixel grain

measured.halo_method: mean luminance in 6 px annuli about (368, 372)
measured.whole_clusters: dark 34 %, blue 20 %, gray-teal 15 %, mid green 10 %, light green 9 %, mint 6 %, pale 5 %

benchmark.computed: live, when this page loads, by the code that measured the reference: default parameters, Video blue palette, 1× reference size

setup.note: Orbits and core are generated; the ground patch is in place, the ring and halo patches were placed with search.py.

limits: Benchmark mean 0.82. The ground patches miss on autocorrelation (about 0.6) and histogram: the reference noise correlates 0.88 at lag 1 and still 0.35 at lag 6, which is JPEG block structure on top of 3 px specks; the plate's specks are 3 px blobs over a 3.2 px clump grid and fall to 0.1 by lag 3. Coordinate descent reached 0.85 only by raising per-pixel grain to 87 levels, which was refused for the look; the default keeps 20.

The ring stroke patch misses on ink shares (0.55 to 0.65): the reference strokes overlap as several hand passes of mint over blue, the plate draws one pass per orbit with a fringe, so the patch found by search.py carries more ground.
The halo's dark ink color scores 0.26 because the plate's halo has no dark-blue pockets at 60 px; the bite reaches 0.4 of the lit tone, not to the ground.
Orbits and core are the plate's own; the ring and halo patches were placed with search.py.
notes: Deterministic: the same palette, parameters and seed give the same pixels.
A display render is capped at 2.4 megapixels; a slider in motion draws at half scale (down to a quarter on a heavy engine) and the release redraws in full.
This spec follows the controls: open it again, or leave it open, after changing them.
